turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I can't decide what to make for dinner on Saturday when my in-laws come over.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait until I've listed everything before you jump in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first idea is a big roast chicken with potatoes and carrots, all in one tray in the oven.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's homemade lasagna, which I could make the night before and just bake when they arrive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is grilled salmon with a lemon sauce and a green salad, lighter but more last minute.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it. Now you can comment.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The lasagna is the least stressful, since you can make it ahead and actually enjoy your guests. The roast chicken is a safe crowd pleaser too, but timing the oven can be tricky. The salmon is lovely, though cooking it at the last minute while people are chatting is a lot of pressure.
